_comment: This file documents required user secrets for WebProject.AppHost.
_comment2: Run scripts/dev-setup.ps1 to check which are missing.
_comment3: Set secrets with: dotnet user-secrets set "Key" "value" --project WebProject.AppHost
_comment4: Run scripts/dev-hydrate.ps1 to pull all values automatically from the staging Key Vault.
_comment5: Key Vault secret names use '--' as separator (e.g. 'PostHog:ProjectToken' -> 'PostHog--ProjectToken').
